senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (בני) builder, mason.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:9">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> top <he>אומנתיה דהן ב׳</he> this boy’s trade should be that of a builder.
<cite ref="Shabbat 156b">Sabb. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ וסתיר וכ׳</he> (shall grow to be one) who builds and destroys, destroys and builds (restless).
<cite ref="Shabbat 115a">Ib. 115ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. V. <cite ref="A03004"><he>אַרְרִּיכָל</he></cite>.—[V. <cite ref="B00937"><he>בַּנָּאִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00937"><he>בַּנָּאִין</he></cite>.]
